findings.category: Source inventory completeness / OWASP A03:2025 Software Supply Chain Failures
findings.description: sourceGuards claims compile-input completeness but its extension allowlist omits .md. The live source contains //go:embed contracts/new-project-rules-v24.md, so a signed SourceFiles inventory can omit this actual compile input without AUTHORITY_SOURCE_OMITTED.
findings.impact: The automatic source-closure guard does not prove full compile-input lineage. Accepted Root/control binary hashes still prevent this omission alone from changing the executed program; no authority bypass is claimed.
findings.scenario: Create/review a release inventory containing every required current allowlisted member but omitting internal/domain/contracts/new-project-rules-v24.md. Static control flow ignores that file at line 154; no missing-source error follows from its omission. This is a static counterexample, not an executed PoC.
findings.recommendation: Derive the release inventory from Root's accepted build dependency/EmbedFiles inventory and verify every compile input, or add explicit mandatory embedded-input coverage including the actual .md. Add one focused negative native/source test omitting this real embedded input. Keep accepted binary pins.
findings.code_example:
// root-produced accepted build inventory must include GoFiles, assembly/syso, EmbedFiles and module/toolchain inputs;
// reject if any such normalized member is absent from SourceFiles before retaining handles.
findings.release_gate: Full compile-input inventory claim must be corrected before an anchored production-ready Source is accepted.

positive_observations: All 26 MF members hash-match; HDF/MF hash and sizes match parent-provided exact pins. 20 candidate Source files and 28 total revision files.
Empty issuer key rejects before grant/native authority. Provisioning a fresh key does not populate the compiled constant. Signer also requires its private key public half equal the compiled issuer.

Offline signer uses strict typed decoding and exact json.Marshal byte comparison before Ed25519 signing. This prevents signing duplicate/unknown fields or whitespace that envelope marshaling would silently change. Receiver strict rejects unknown fields; ordinary JSON cannot create Token state.

Outer envelope parser itself accepts duplicate known fields according to Go semantics, but signed selected raw payload plus whole release/grant digest bindings do not establish an unsigned override. No duplicate-field privilege escalation identified.

Root/control application paths and build settings are checked; peer/self process birth is represented losslessly as decimal strings. HMAC key is generated by Root and delivered only through its intended inherited bootstrap.

Read pinned Go 1.27.1 source: syscall exec_windows.go:407-424 supplies PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_HANDLE_LIST, and os/file_windows.go:83-91 detects nonblocking handles for os.NewFile. No unsupported-deadline finding is asserted from older Go behavior.

Token guards stay live across the DB use; control defers DB.Close after token.Close registration, so DB closes before lease/guards on ordinary return. Root keeps guards while child waits; Job close kills child on parent loss.

Before child launch the new grant nonce is CREATE_NEW and synced; crashes consume this grant. Copies of Token share state; Begin rejects committed state; rollback retry requires same proof and live native state. Migration has distinct type/purpose/grant filename/nonce directory.

Core v4 prepared_run_abandonment.go has same bytes/hash as v3 baseline used by this Source; v4 changes only tests. Source keeps original v1 validation plus a separate historical schema path and a final native recheck before CAS.

Current OWNER is checked under the same write-lock transaction as original CAS; private authority is not installed on ordinary Service. Prepared profile exclusion remains narrow; known record effects are not equated with provider request count.
Historical original signature and exact old JobClosedUTC remain absent; current root signs adoption only. Source does not reopen historical PID or renew original 300-second clock/once marker.

readiness_blocks.detail: enrolledIssuerPublicKeyHex is empty. This is intentional fail-closed behavior, not production authority. A newly pinned Source revision and independent build/review are required after public key provisioning.

apps/control/prepared_recovery_windows.go:59 requires domain.ExecutePreparedAbandonmentSchemaUpgrade supplied by separate schema-upgrade Source. Source HDF composition_dependency.manifest_ref is null. Complete-control compilation/closure cannot be accepted from these 20 files alone.

No Root actual offline-build/test/native positive+hostile-bootstrap receipt supplied to this reviewer yet. Authored tests exercise helpers/zero rejection; no test in this Source demonstrates fully signed release + accepted real Root + accepted real control + token creation + current OWNER/CAS flow. Do not label those helper tests real production producer proof.

Source HDF explicitly reports first 2 read-only bootstrap exec calls not stored (original chunks c67fd6, 3a04ef, fb6b30). Review does not reconstruct them. Refreshed input hashes establish present bytes, not those missing original calls.
Complete-source automatic omission check misses actual embedded .md input; fix and test or narrow the claim before production acceptance.

required_root_verification: Build standalone offline enrollment from exact pinned Source in isolated integration root; provision only new purpose-specific DPAPI resources; outputs/receipts contain only public keys.
Resolve exact schema-upgrade Source HDF/MF, compose v4 unchanged tests and all needed base members, then build full control/root/enrollment with pinned toolchain/build settings.

Use a newly sealed anchored Source and signed accepted release to run genuine Root->control positive bootstrap; capture actual PID/birth/SID/image, job assignment, file guards and DataRootLease lifecycle.

Run hostile native cases: unrelated pipe PID/image/SID/birth, fabricated bootstrap key/handle, wrong signature/purpose/nonce, replay consumed grant, root death/job close, reparse/path replacement/file-ID mismatch, missing raw/history source member, expired grant, stale OWNER/CAS state.
Preserve old immutable v1 fixtures and core footprint failures; historical-specific acceptance must be validated separately. Do not reset original business run/once/clock.

Run dependency vulnerability assessment on the composed exact build/toolchain when authorized. Source adds no go.mod/go.sum or package-manager install scripts; static import review and public module lookup do not establish CVE-free status.
